projection.basis: Visually reviewed Comune di Venezia reconstruction volume page 144 (PDF page 183): the four labelled plans AB, CD, Pianta cella and EF are top-down orthographic sections on the same scale-marked project plate; the elevation and longitudinal section are excluded.

transform: translation only, equal x/y units; floor stacking is display-only
review: The post-reconstruction volume was issued for the Comune di Venezia in 1912. Page 144 (PDF 183) was inspected at high resolution: all four horizontal plans are complete within their crops and the page caption identifies them as the general Commission project. Page 173 (PDF 212) documents thirty-six reconstructed ramps and an electric lift, but the plan plate does not label the lift shaft or the current ticket entrance.

claims.classification: Anchor lies in the open interior of the explicitly captioned Pianta EF at the base of the cusp shown by the adjacent E-F section line.
Anchor is placed on the stair treads drawn beside the central opening in Pianta EF.
The longitudinal section on the same project plate shows the repeated ramp sequence rising from Pianta AB through section CD; page 173 states that the tower contains thirty-six reconstructed ramps.
The page 144 longitudinal section connects the repeated tower ramps to the bell-cell stair shown in Pianta cella.

The page 144 section and text on page 148 describe ramps from the bell cell to the terrace around the dado and another stair giving access above; Pianta cella and Pianta EF each draw the corresponding stair.

projection.basis: Visually reviewed Comune di Venezia reconstruction volume page 144 (PDF page 183): the four labelled plans AB, CD, Pianta cella and EF are top-down orthographic sections on the same scale-marked project plate; the elevation and longitudinal section are excluded.

Visually reviewed Cicognara 1858 plate 15. Its ground and bell-cell plans remain an archival comparison only; no generated floor selects this source because it predates the 1902 collapse and 1912 reconstruction.
